headlines.label: Overtakes
headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: ALO (9)

summary: George Russell won the Canadian Grand Prix from pole position, 0.2s ahead of Max Verstappen, with Kimi Antonelli completing the podium.
Carlos Sainz made the biggest climb, from P16 to P10.
Lando Norris had a day to forget, dropping from P7 to P18.
The race was neutralised by 1 safety car.
The stewards penalised STR (10 second time penalty).
There were 82 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 5 times.
Rain fell at some point during the race.
Oscar Piastri leads the championship by 22 points over Lando Norris.
